# MapLibre GL JS 6.12.0

Pinned, unmodified browser modules, worker, shared module and CSS downloaded
from https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.12.0/ (npm distribution).
Source: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js
Keep LICENSE.txt with the library. The worker and modules are served locally;
vector styles, glyphs, sprites and tiles are requested from OpenFreeMap online.
